# Close Recap, Fri Nov 13, 2026 (pulled ~4:18 PM ET)

**Cool PPI pop got sold. The NVDA scandal spread to the whole chip complex, and QQQ took the hit.** PPI came in cool at 8:30 (+0.3% m/m vs +0.4%), but the open reversed at 9:30. New reports tied Dell servers with restricted Nvidia chips to a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, and Bessent asked "did Nvidia know their client" (Benzinga). That turned into an unwind of the week's NVDA-to-rivals rotation: **AMD −8.75%, AVGO −4.8%, SMH −3.0%**. All three ETFs closed their 9:45 bars below their pre-market lows. They then fell through Thursday's PDLs and bottomed around 10:21–11:22. Midday Daly said "in all likelihood we will need to raise rates", and they spent the afternoon grinding back. **SPY −0.38%, QQQ −1.20%, IWM −0.32%; Dow +0.10%.** After 3:47 came the Hormuz tanker mines and a **national FAA ground stop at 3:57**. Futures slipped after the bell: ES 7561.5 and NQ 27923.5 at 4:07.

Sources: Quant Data API on the user's account (GEX by strike, dark pool, 9k+ unconsolidated flow; pulled 4:17 PM ET), Yahoo Finance (1m/15m bars, futures, indexes, VIX, yields, DXY, oil, gold, stocks), the Financial Juice RSS feed, Benzinga, Reuters (via Euronext), Motley Fool, Yahoo Finance news, X News, @Team2Trading on X, NY Fed / Globe and Mail / Investing.com / StockTitan calendars. **Caveats:**
- Positioning came from the Quant Data API, not the browser My Pages. The 'contract flow' Session Date wasn't touched.
- The Financial Juice feed only went back to 10:49. Drivers before that come from Benzinga/Reuters and the 8:56 data check.
- Yahoo shows one SPY 1m low of 745.20 at 11:38. Yahoo's daily bar and Quant Data both show the low at 747.88–747.90 (10:21), so the 745.20 print is treated as a bad tick.

## Morning levels: held or broke

- **SPY** (PM 755.8–762.6; lid 759.7–760, shelf 757, magnets 753.7/750):
  - **Rejected at the lid.** The high was 760.12 on the first print. It never got back to the 762.6 PMH or the 763 PDH.
  - **The 757 shelf broke** on the 9:30 bar (756.00 close). **The 755.8 PML broke** on the 9:45 bar (754.40 close). That's Team2's 9:45 close below a key level.
  - **753.7 (Thursday's PDL) broke** on the 10:00 bar (749.04). **The 750 magnet hit.** The low was 747.88 at 10:21, and 750 pinned price from 10:15 to 11:45 (15-min closes 749.6–750.9).
  - It recovered to close **754.21**, still under the old PML and the 757 shelf.
- **QQQ** (PM 685.0–693.1; cap 690, shelf 684.7–685, magnet 680):
  - It opened at 688.5 and **never reached the 690 cap**.
  - **The 685 shelf/PML broke** on the 9:30 bar (683.80 close). **The 680 magnet and Thursday's 679.84 PDL broke** on the 10:00 bar (674.06 close).
  - It extended to **671.71 at 11:22**, then climbed back to close **679.89, right on 680 / the old PDL**.
- **IWM** (PM 277.9–280.65; floor 278–278.5, lid 279.3–280):

  - It reclaimed 275 quickly and closed **277.54, just under the old 277.9–278 floor**.

  - Sign changes: **681–684**, 686, 690, 692.
